{{Top|leg}}
The '''Verkuylian Resistance''' was a resistance group who opposed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They were slow to rebel as most on [[Verkuyl]] viewed the Empire as liberators, as the conditions they faced before the Empire nationalized Verkuyl, were much worse. Eventually some Verkuylians were won over by members of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and began to openly rebel against the Imperial regime on Verkuyl. They worked with a group of [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] operatives to liberate Verkuyl and were nearly thwarted by [[Daven Quarle]], who was actually aligned with the Empire.
